title: Targeted synthesis of a trimethoxyphenyltetrahydropyrimidine analogue designed as a DNA intercalator: in silico, multi-spectroscopic, thermodynamic, and in vitro approaches
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14946-14965

Based on the rational design of DNA intercalators and Topo-II inhibitors like doxorubicin (Dox) as a reference standard; methoxyphenyltetrahydropyrimidine aa trimethoxyphenyltetrahydropyrimidine analogue was designed as a DNA intercalator.
